ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) background with significant low-intensity (black) mottling and central pigmentation; approximate macro-level ratio of 60:40.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central base is a contiguous low-intensity region. Left lobe features a distinct vertical dark streak in the medial zone and dark clusters at the distal tip. Right lobe exhibits a complex, dendritic network of low-intensity streaks and spots across the medial and lateral surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with an estimated aperture angle of 70-80 degrees and a depth approximately 15% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated trailing edge. Right lobe features approximately 6 distinct sharp peaks with visible pixel amplitudes of 10-15 units. Left lobe exhibits lower-frequency, shallower serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in pointed, slightly upturned tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small, circular dark pixel aggregates on the inner right lobe, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent diagonal linear mark on the left lobe medial area; multiple fine, intersecting linear streaks on the right lobe forming a dense rake-like pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable diagonal scar on the left lobe; heavy irregular dark pigmentation and scarring across the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The branching, dendritic-like dark pigmentation pattern on the right fluke lobe serves as a highly unique identifier.
